author: Nate Miller
title: Mike Yastrzemski belts grand slam in Thursday's win
desc: Mike Yastrzemski went 1-for-3 with a grand slam, two walks, and two runs scored in Thursday's 10-5 win over the Pirates.
impact: With the Braves only up one in the top of the ninth inning Thursday afternoon, Yastrzemski stepped to the plate with the bases juiced and pretty much finished off the Pirates with the third grand slam of his career. Yastrzemski is seeing the ball well right now. Over the Braves' last six games, the veteran outfielder has gone 6-for-17 with two homers, a double, four walks, and eight RBI.

author: Nate Miller
title: Matt Olson continues recent power surge
desc: Matt Olson went 1-for-3 with a solo homer, two walks, and two runs scored in Thursday's 10-5 win over the Pirates.
impact: Olson got the Braves going Thursday afternoon, launching his 25th homer of the season in the top of the first inning. The All-Star slugger has now hit five deep drives over his last seven games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) will return Friday
desc: White Sox manager Will Venable confirmed that Munetaka Murakami will return to the lineup on Friday.
impact: Murakami began a rehab assignment this week. He'll be back for the final series going into the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Elder surrenders three homers in Thursday's outing
desc: Bryce Elder allowed four runs (three earned) on five hits and two walks while striking out three over four innings in Thursday's 10-5 win against the Pirates.
impact: Elder only gave up five hits in Thursday afternoon's start, but three of them left the yard. That's been the main issue for Elder lately, as he's surrendered multiple homers in three of his last four starts. During that span, Elder has posted an ugly 11.00 ERA with eight total long balls allowed across 18 innings. He was very good for a stretch out of the gate this season, but Elder is best left on waivers in fantasy leagues now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Philip Abner recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks recalled Philip Abner from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Abner will add a fresh arm in the bullpen for Arizona heading into the final few games before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks optioned Jose Cabrera to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Cabrera struggled over four recent starts in the majors for Arizona. It is unclear if he'll return to the rotation following the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brad Lord (side) placed on IL
desc: The Nationals placed Brad Lord on the 15-day injured list with left side tightness.
impact: Lord will be sidelined through the All-Star break. He will miss at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) to make rehab start Sunday
desc: Jordan Montgomery will make his next rehab start on Sunday for Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery is scheduled to pitch around four innings. He could be ready to return shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Bradford (elbow) resuming rehab assignment
desc: Cody Bradford is resuming his rehab assignment at Double-A Corpus Christi on Sunday.
impact: Bradford was pulled from his previous rehab assignment back in April. He is working his way back from an internal brace procedure.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seiya Suzuki (calf) exits early Thursday
desc: Seiya Suzuki left Thursday's game against the Orioles due to cramps in his calf.
impact: Suzuki was removed from Thursday's game late in the eighth inning. He'll be further evaluated at which point an update should be provided.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dillon Dingler (hand) not in lineup Thursday
desc: Dillon Dingler is not in the Tigers lineup on Thursday against the Athletics.
impact: Dingler left Wednesday's game after a foul tip hit him in the right thumb. He had X-rays came back clean and remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Garrett Stallings optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers optioned Garrett Stallings to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Stallings returns to Triple-A to make room for Logan Henderson getting activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson (back) activated from IL
desc: The Brewers activated Logan Henderson from the injured list.
impact: Henderson makes his way back from the injured list to start on Thursday against the Cardinals. Garrett Stallings was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Jung (knee) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Josh Jung is back in the Rangers lineup on Thursday against the Angels.
impact: Jung returns from a multi-game absence. He is back hitting cleanup and starting at third base.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Smith optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rangers optioned Josh Smith to Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Smith returns to Triple-A with Wyatt Langford activated from the injured list.
